title: Normalized exact compactification units respect canonical refinements
statement:
Let A be a finite commutative ring, f:X→Y a separated finite-type quasi-compact morphism of Noetherian schemes, F an additive exact functor of constant-A module sheaves, c,d compactifications, and a:F≅jc!⋙pc*, b:F≅jd!⋙pd*. Suppose a and b have the same composite with the compactification inclusion into f*. Then δ(c,F,a) followed by the canonical comparison from c to d equals δ(d,F,b).
Conventions and constructions: [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-sfb-exact-compactification-unit], [def-asd-compact-support-graph-comparison], [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons].

proof.text: For a proper refinement, the sheaf proper/open map preserves sections inside ordinary direct image. The common inclusion normalization therefore identifies its composite with the two supplied sheaf isomorphisms, because the compactification inclusion is injective.

Represent a homotopy complex by a K-injective resolution of the finer open extension. The proper/open comparison is normalized by this resolution. Proper direct image preserves K-injectives, and the derived-composition unit identity identifies the two resolution maps. Localization full faithfulness descends equality.
For arbitrary compactifications use their common proper refinement and the two preceding equalities. Cancel the invertible refinement map. This is exactly the canonical common-refinement comparison.

theorem exactCompactificationUnit_refinement
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ⥤
      Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))
    [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F] [PreservesFiniteColimits F]
    (c d : Compactification f)
    (a : F ≅ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) c.g)
    (b : F ≅ openImmersionLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.i ⋙
      lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) d.g)
    (hab : a.hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage A c =
      b.hom ≫ compactificationSheafToDirectImage A d) :
    exactCompactificationUnit A c F a ≫
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso A c d).hom =
        exactCompactificationUnit A d F b
